Django News Application
  • Quickstart and usage

Quickstart and usage

This page assumes the application is running at http://127.0.0.1:8000/ (see Installation).

Load demo data

The quickest way to try every role is to load the demo data:

python manage.py seed_demo

This creates a publisher called Demo News, one approved article, an API token for each user, and three accounts that share the password DemoPass123!:

Username

Role

Notes

demo_reader

Reader

Subscribed to Demo News and to demo_writer.

demo_writer

Journalist

Affiliated with Demo News.

demo_editor

Editor

Editor for Demo News.

Warning

The demo accounts use a published password. Use them only on your own computer and never on a public server.

Walkthrough

  1. Sign in as the journalist. Go to /login/ and sign in as demo_writer. Choose Submit article, enter a title and content, and optionally choose Demo News as the publisher. The article is saved unapproved, so it is not yet on the home page.

  2. Approve it as the editor. Sign out, sign in as demo_editor, and open Review articles (/editor/review/). Select Approve. The application emails the article to subscribed readers. In local development emails are printed to the terminal running runserver.

  3. Read it as the reader. Sign in as demo_reader. The article is on the home page. Open Subscriptions (/subscriptions/) to change which publishers and journalists you follow.

  4. Create a newsletter. As the journalist or editor, open Newsletters and choose Create newsletter to bundle approved articles together.

To create your own accounts, use Register (/register/) and pick the reader or journalist role. Editor accounts are created by an administrator in the Django admin site (/admin/).

Web pages

URL

Who can use it

Purpose

/

Everyone

Approved articles.

/register/

Everyone

Create a reader or journalist account.

/login/, /logout/

Everyone

Sign in and out.

/articles/<id>/

Signed-in users

Read an approved article.

/articles/new/

Journalists

Submit an article.

/articles/<id>/edit/, /articles/<id>/delete/

Editors; journalists for their own independent articles

Change or remove an article.

/editor/review/

Editors

Articles waiting for approval.

/newsletters/

Signed-in users

Browse newsletters.

/newsletters/new/, /newsletters/<id>/edit/, /newsletters/<id>/delete/

Journalists and editors

Manage newsletters.

/subscriptions/

Readers

Follow publishers and journalists.

/admin/

Staff users

Django admin site.

Each page is implemented by a view in news.views.

Run the tests

python manage.py test

The tests need the database server to be reachable, because Django creates a temporary test database.
